format.description: The version of this file format. Always 1.

id.description: A name for this level, like "level-1". It matches the file name.

tileset.description: The tileset whose letters the rows use, by the id in its file, like "meadow". Left out means # is solid and . is empty.

sky.description: The colour behind the level, which also fills the bars beside it, as # and six digits, like #9fd3f0. Left out means that light blue.

ground.description: The colour of the solid tiles, as # and six digits, like #3b4a5a. Left out means that slate.

tiles.description: The map, one text row per line, top to bottom. # is solid ground and . is empty air. With a tileset, each letter is one of its tiles.

id.description: A name for this thing, used once in this level, like "crate-1".

character.description: Which character this thing is, by the id in its character file, like "crate".

x.description: Where the middle of the thing is, in tiles from the left edge.

y.description: Where the middle of the thing is, in tiles from the top edge.

things.description: The things standing in the level, like crates. Can be empty.

x.description: Where the hero starts, in tiles from the left edge.

y.description: Where the hero starts, in tiles from the top edge.

starts.description: Where each player begins. At least one is needed.
